recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: wood coached over years into the outline of a chair
spring analyst PDFs thick with talk of what software swallows next
a drumbeat suggesting slower moves instead of stampeding fear
late may clarity over the bay, wind picking up through the afternoon
pop ledger lines quietly rewinding in warm bureaucratic light

composer-2-fast.concept: Tap on a rising stutter-house pulse to coax wireframe branches until they snap into a miniature chair lattice—off-beat taps saw off wrong twigs.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm-tap pruning that grows a correct silhouette under a BPM that creeps upward.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Tap on the beat; long-press occasionally to hold a growth ring.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: One furniture form finishes in under a minute with a crisp satisfying locking click.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Tempo ramps, extra phantom beats try to bait mis-taps, branches fork faster.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Blue-print arborist lines on charcoal with neon pulse accents

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag a single glowing thread through shrinking hoops labeled hype vs signal; you must periodically release to enter slow-mo breaths or the thread frays.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Path drag with mandatory hold-release slow windows.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Drag to steer the thread; release on cue to breathe.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing the last hoop feels like snapping a rubber band of noise off your focus.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: More hoops, shorter slow windows, stray particles tug the thread off course.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Sticky-note pastel planner with foil glare

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Flip face-down waveform tiles on a tiny grid; match pairs that belong to the same dream-pop phrase before the fog layer refreezes them.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Memory pair matching with a fog timer that re-hides unmatched tiles.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Completing the phrase plays a one-bar harmonic bloom and clears the board shimmer.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Grid grows, fog returns quicker, decoy near-duplicate tiles appear.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Violet haze, chrome crescent icons, soft grain

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe gust lanes across a gold-hour skyline so horizontal fog bands align with scrolling music bars—misaligned bands stack into unreadable noise.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Lane swipes that shear drifting layers into sync.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Short directional swipes left/right per lane.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: When bars lock, the whole skyline inhales into one clean horizon stroke.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Crosswinds introduce diagonal drift, bars scroll faster, rogue jetstreams appear.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: SF spring sunset wash with brushed glass UI
